posts.text: Year-to-year variability in the melting of the surface of the Greenland Ice Sheet may not be a harbinger of ice sheet destabilization, according to a study. Variability in the surface mass balance is an expected response to climate warming. In PNAS: https://ow.ly/2qq250ZMEvb
